ref: #2 §5 counter: "Number of calls for this target-field mapping where you specify the initial value and the increment" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/43/c4cdfc334824478090739c04c4a249/content.htm]; assumed reading of #37 (obs-shared-box): a counter counts the values of its own target field mapping, so each target field's counter starts at its initial value; formatVersion 1 has no box shared by two target fields (ADR-0010), so this is obs-shared-box's shared-2
note: The input s1.xml of obs-shared-box: three orders with an Id each. V's counter N1 and W's counter N2 each count 1, 2, 3 across the Order contexts, so Item i has V = W = i. A counter shared across target fields would give W = 4, 5, 6 (shared-1).
